title: Higher Regularity of Time-Periodic Solutions to Nonautonomous Hyperbolic Problems: Away from Resonances
summary: We study higher regularity and its relation to nonresonant behavior for time-periodic solutions of boundary value problems for one-dimensional linear and nonlinear nonautonomous first-order integro-differential strictly hyperbolic systems. The boundary conditions include integral operators and various types of boundary reflections. We prove that continuous and classical solutions have $C^k$-regularity, provided the coefficients are sufficiently smooth and a suitable number of nonresonance conditions is satisfied.
